component.name: MyGOFrame
component.summary: Play console games through a capture-card preview

description.p: MyGOFrame displays a V4L2 capture device in a native window and monitors a selected PipeWire audio input through your speakers or headphones.

Select the video format, resolution, frame rate, and input color range. Adjust audio monitoring volume or open a separate video-only window for application sharing. The preview preserves the video aspect ratio when either window is resized.

Record to MKV or MP4 with H.264, HEVC, or AV1 hardware encoding on a compatible GPU. Choose the GPU and bitrate, record capture-card audio, and control speaker monitoring independently. Save named presets and inspect application information and open-source license notices.
Hardware recording, saved presets, native app and license dialogs, domain-based source organization, and smoother recording previews.
